$comment: Manifest row documentation for the content pass (one JSON object per line). One row per artifact.

bytes.description: Artifact size in bytes, or the string download_failed.

evidence_quote.description: Short quote (max 300 chars) from the content supporting the verdict.

identifier.description: Canonical ID matching the staging record.

reason.description: Why this verdict; for failures, the classified cause.

source_url.description: URL the artifact was fetched from (with fallback chain on failure).

text_chars.description: Extracted-text length when content was verified, else null.

title: very-deep-search content manifest row
